recipe.description: Cass Vesper original art direction: balanced narrow-shouldered adult silhouette, softly angular cheeks, a broader chin plane, moderate straight nose projection and separately fitted ears/glasses. Upstream graphical-control names do not establish age, ethnicity, gender identity, occupation beyond the canon, wealth or biography.

source_indices: All source vertex/UV/face/triangle indices are zero based. Face IDs count every OBJ f line. Triangle IDs count every original face fan triangle, including discarded body regions and helper groups.
lod: Original retained face topology is shared. No simplification or detail-destroying decimation is applied.
